methodologyNotes: Roster covers 13 hard-floor steam mops/steam cleaners spanning entry-level to prosumer tiers. The originally requested Bissell SpinWave 3115 is a robotic vacuum/mop (not a steam mop) and was replaced by the writer with the verified corded Bissell SpinWave SmartSteam 3897A from the same brand family; that substitution is correct. Primary sources are manufacturer product pages (Bissell, SharkNinja, Dupray, Tineco, McCulloch, PurSteam, O-Cedar, Light N Easy); secondary sources include retailer listings, instruction manuals, and Consumer Reports for spec corroboration. Spec values carry units inline where applicable; booleans indicate feature presence; tank_capacity_ml is the published clean-water fill volume in milliliters; heat_up_time_sec is seconds to first steam; cord_length_ft is the AC power cord only; steam_levels is the integer count of user-selectable output settings (null where not enumerated by the maker); max_run_time_min is continuous steam minutes per full tank (null for corded designs where runtime is not meaningfully bounded by tank size). Adversarial re-verification on 2026-06-20 corrected four fields: Shark Genius tank 500->350 ml, PurSteam cord 28->16 ft, Bissell 3897A price 139.99->159.99, and Bissell Symphony 1132A price set null (discontinued, no single published US price; retailers span ~$124-$310). accessedAt 2026-06-20.

products.name: Bissell PowerFresh Scrubbing & Sanitizing Steam Mop 1940
products.provenance: Verified on Bissell.com 1940A page (2026-06-20): price $99.99, clean tank 16 oz (473 ml), 23 ft cord, 30 sec heat-up, 3 SmartSet digital steam settings, swivel steering, washable pads. Release year not published by Bissell; earliest Amazon reviews date to ~2013, so release left null.

products.name: Bissell PowerFresh Slim 3-in-1 Sanitizing Steam Mop 2075A
products.provenance: Verified on Bissell.com 2075A page (2026-06-20): price $179.99, clean tank 11.8 oz (349 ml), 25 ft cord, swivel head, washable pads. Heat-up time not on product page; ~30 sec per Bissell PowerFresh line norm and third-party reviews. Discrete steam-level count not enumerated on product page; null used.

products.name: Shark Steam Pocket Mop S3501
products.provenance: Verified on SharkNinja S3501 page (2026-06-20): price $99.99, 18 ft cord, swivel steering, 2 washable double-sided microfiber pads. Tank ~450 ml (15 oz) per owner manual/retailer specs. Heat-up 30 sec corroborated by multiple sources. Single fixed steam output (no user-selectable levels). Newegg/early Amazon listings indicate ~2010 launch.

products.name: Shark Genius Steam Pocket Mop S5003D
products.provenance: CORRECTED: tank capacity changed from 500 ml to 350 ml per official S5003D user manual (several retailer listings cite 220 ml fill level; manual lists 350 ml total). 22 ft cord and 3 Intelligent Steam Control settings (Low/Med/High) confirmed by The Steam Queen review and listings. Swivel head, 2 washable Dirt Grip pads confirmed. Discontinued; SharkNinja page redirects to Quick Flip Pro, so retail-range pricing used.

products.name: O-Cedar Microfiber Steam Mop
products.provenance: Tank 400 ml, heat-up 20 sec, 20 ft cord (some listings show 19 ft), triangular swivel head, machine-washable microfiber pad confirmed across Amazon listing, TechGearLab review, and GadgetFlow. Price ~$67.99-$70. Adjustable steam dial present but discrete level count not published; null used. No model number beyond ASIN B00US9PSKU.

products.name: McCulloch MC1275 Heavy-Duty Steam Cleaner
products.provenance: Verified on official McCulloch page (2026-06-20): price $169.99, 48 oz (1420 ml) tank, 8-minute (480 sec) heat-up, 45-minute continuous steam, 16 ft power cord. Canister-style cleaner with rigid mop attachment; no swivel mop head. Washable mop pads. Single steam output (no variable adjustment).

products.name: Light N Easy Multi-Functional Steam Mop 7688ANW
products.provenance: 3 steam modes (HI/MED/LOW) confirmed by HouseholdMe review and Amazon listing. 18 ft cord, swivel head, washable microfiber pad confirmed. Tank: the Amazon listing publishes 3.15 fl oz (93 ml) and this value is consistently reproduced by multiple aggregators, so it is retained as the manufacturer-stated figure per the methodology (listed fill volume) -- though it is implausibly small and likely a detachable-floor-head sub-tank rather than the full reservoir; flagged as low-confidence on this single field.

products.name: Bissell Symphony All-in-One Vacuum & Steam Mop 1132A
products.priceNote: No single published US price: discontinued; retailers span ~$124 (Walmart) to ~$310 (eVacuumStore list), Best Buy ~$226. Set null rather than guess.
products.provenance: CORRECTED: priceUsd set to null. The Bissell 1132A page does not publish a fixed price (shows only a percentage-off badge) and the model is discontinued; third-party retailers vary widely (~$124 to ~$310), so no reliable single US price exists. Tank 12.8 oz (379 ml), 25 ft cord, and swivel head 'No' confirmed on the Bissell page. Heat-up ~30 sec per manual. Two steam settings (Low/High) per third-party review. Washable soft + scrubby microfiber pads confirmed.

products.name: PurSteam ThermaPro 10-in-1 Steam Mop (Therma Pro 211)
products.priceNote: Sale $89.99 / regular $99.99 per PurSteam official store
products.provenance: CORRECTED: cord_length_ft changed from 28 ft to 16 ft per the Therma Pro 211 instruction manual and Consumer Reports/Apartment Therapy spec reporting (28 ft was unsupported). Price verified on PurSteam store: sale $89.99 / regular $99.99. Tank 12 oz (380 ml). Heat-up 30 sec. Runtime per full tank: ~12 min at maximum steam, up to ~25 min at lowest setting; 25 retained as max_run_time_min (longest continuous runtime). Swivel head and washable pads confirmed. Discrete steam-level count not enumerated; null used.

products.name: Dupray Neat Steam Cleaner
products.provenance: Verified on Dupray.com (2026-06-20): price $179.98, 54 oz (1600 ml) tank, 8-minute (480 sec) heat-up, 16 ft (5 m) cord, up to 50-minute continuous runtime, launched 2018. Single steam level (no variable adjustment). Canister design, mop head does not swivel. Washable microfiber pads included.

products.name: Tineco Floor One S5 Steam
products.priceNote: Launch MSRP July 2022 per Tineco; street price has declined since
products.provenance: Corded wet/dry vacuum with steam (ASIN B09QFHPPZD). Clean water tank 750 ml (0.75 L), 26 ft cord, swivel steering, ~15 min steam-mode runtime confirmed via Tineco store listing and 2022 launch press release ($449, July 2022). Heat-up time and discrete steam-level count not published; nulled. Pad data not specified for this wet/dry category product; nulled (null beats a guess).

products.name: Bissell SpinWave SmartSteam Scrubbing & Sanitizing Spin Mop 3897A
products.provenance: CORRECTED: priceUsd changed from 139.99 to 159.99 per Bissell.com 3897A page. Clean tank 538 ml, 15 sec heat-up, 2 steam levels plus no-steam mode, 25 ft cord, swivel steering, washable rotating microfiber spin pads, 230 RPM, LED headlights all confirmed on Bissell page. This is the current corded SpinWave steam mop replacing the originally-requested SpinWave 3115 (a robotic vacuum/mop, not a steam mop).
